name: The Keeper's Guide
descriptions: A worn, leather-bound book filled with handwritten notes and sketches of the lighthouse and its surroundings.

chapters.title: Introduction
chapters.content: This book belongs to the lighthouse, not the keepers, but it is for the lighthouse to reveal to any new keeper how to best serve it.
